  "type": { ... },
  "author": { ... },

    "title": "string",
    "year": integer,
    ...
  },
  ...
}
```

So the initial format specifies year as integer. Then they say "You MUST respond with valid JSON matching this exact schema" and present a schema where year is string. This might be a test of following the initial extraction rules vs schema. Usually in these prompts, the schema at the end is the authoritative one for validation.
